title: 1930s homesteader accounts of cattle mutilation on the property
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of 1930s homesteader accounts of cattle mutilation on the property, about 1930s-1980s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Our investigation has unearthed the fact that there are accounts that go back to the 1930s with the early homesteaders of bizarre cattle mutilation and other strange activity on this property.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events, says his team's investigation turned up old stories. According to him, accounts going back to the early settlers of the 1930s describe bizarre cattle mutilation, cows found dead with odd injuries, and other strange activity on the land. If true, it would mean the strangeness there is not new but goes back generations.
